### Week 8 Discussion Questions.

1.  **Review the Meyer et al. (2001) article on effect sizes.** Identify a relationship from Table 1 or Table 2 that you think is interesting / have heard about in other classes. Write this relationship out as a model.
2.  **REPLY TO ANOTHER PERSON :** Apply the “four reasons” framework to evaluate why their relationship might occur.
3.  **ON THE DIG DEEPER TAB : Complete Part 2 (Evaluating the Measures and Methods).** Okay if you have questions or are confused - just do your best. Highlight any questions / places where you are stuck in yellow to help flag them for me (and us!) I've posted an example to help get y'all started.
